rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the cutting tool.

example.english: These scissors are very blunt, so I need to take them to be sharpened.
example.traditional: 呢把鉸剪好鈍，要攞去磨一磨。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 gaau3 zin2 hou2 deon6 jiu3 lo2 heoi3 mo4 jat1 mo4

rows.note: Use this short noun for the scissors hand in rock-paper-scissors.

example.english: I played scissors, you played paper, and I won this round.
example.traditional: 我出剪，你出紙，今鋪我贏。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 zin2 nei5 ceot1 zi2 gam1 pou1 ngo5 jeng4
